title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Pierre Strong Jr. quiet in Week 9
items.desc: Pierre Strong Jr. rushed eight times for 22 yards while also catching both of his targets for 11 yards in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots in Week 9.
items.impact: Strong Jr. has struggled to make an impact out of the Green Bay backfield of late, logging less than 35 offensive yards in each of his last four contests. The running back remains difficult to trust as more of a change-of-pace backfield option to this point, with a Week 10 contest against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (elbow) has MRI return clean, to be monitored
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II underwent an MRI following Sunday's win and the tests did not reveal a major injury.
items.impact: Mahomes had left Sunday's game in pain before he returned to the field. His elbow strain/sprain will be monitored over the next few days for pain and swelling.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kaleb Johnson reaches end zone in Week 9 win
items.desc: Kaleb Johnson carried the ball 14 times for a team-leading 68 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 45-27 win over the Patriots in Week 9.
items.impact: Johnson took advantage of increased touches after Josh Jacobs (hand) exited, rushing for over 60 yards for the first time this season. The running back could be in line for increased touches if Jacobs is to miss time entering a Week 10 contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Packers D/ST disruptive in Week 9
items.desc: The Packers D/ST recorded four sacks while also forcing four turnovers (three interceptions, one fumble recovery) in a 45-27 win over the Patriots in Week 9.
items.impact: The defense took advantage of an overmatched New England offensive line, allowing less than 100 rushing yards in a winning effort. The unit will look for another disruptive performance against the Minnesota Vikings in Week 10.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Panthers D/ST records interception in Week 9
items.desc: The Carolina Panthers' defense allowed 26 points and 312 total yards while recording one sack and one interception in the team's 26-21 loss to the Denver Broncos in Week 9.
items.impact: Carolina intercepted Bo Nix and held Denver to 82 rushing yards. That's the good. The bad? The Panthers allowed 13 unanswered points in the fourth quarter, including touchdowns from Jonah Coleman and Pat Bryant. Carolina also recorded just one sack. The Panthers D/ST will look to rebound against the Saints in Week 10.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Trey Smack perfect in Week 9
items.desc: Trey Smack converted all four of his extra point attempts as well as each of his three field goal attempts to finish with 13 points in the Packers' 45-27 win over the New England Patriots in Week 9.
items.impact: Smack has provided mixed results of late, logging double-digit points in two of his last four contests. The kicker will look for another impactful performance against the Minnesota Vikings in Week 10.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Ryan Fitzgerald misses field goal in Week 9
items.desc: Ryan Fitzgerald missed his lone field-goal attempt but converted all three extra-point attempts in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
items.impact: Fitzgerald finished with just three points as Carolina scored three touchdowns but failed to convert its only field-goal opportunity. The Panthers have now fallen to 3-5 and will face the Saints in Week 10. Fitzgerald's limited scoring opportunities make him difficult to trust in fantasy lineups.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Jalen Coker records 29 receiving yards in Week 9
items.desc: Jalen Coker caught four of five targets for 29 yards while losing three yards on his lone rushing attempt in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
items.impact: Coker caught four passes, but averaged just 7.3 yards per reception. Meanwhile, Darren Waller and Tetairoa McMillan combined for 146 receiving yards and two touchdowns. Coker continues to receive opportunities, but his production isn't enough to warrant a fantasy start in shallow leagues.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Tommy Tremble catches touchdown in Week 9
items.desc: Tommy Tremble caught four of six targets for 24 yards and one touchdown in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
items.impact: Tremble scored from 10 yards out in the second quarter for Carolina's first touchdown. However, Darren Waller had eight receptions for 90 yards and a touchdown on 10 targets. Tremble's touchdown was useful for no one as Waller remains the Panthers tight end to roster.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Tetairoa McMillan scores touchdown in Week 9
items.desc: Tetairoa McMillan caught four of six targets for 56 yards and one touchdown in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
items.impact: McMillan caught a four-yard touchdown with just over three minutes remaining to pull Carolina within five points. He finished second on the Panthers in receiving yards behind Darren Waller, who saw 10 targets compared to McMillan's six. The touchdown helped, but Waller commanded more opportunities against Denver. McMillan remains a starting option in fantasy leagues heading into Week 10.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jacobs suffers broken finger Sunday, status uncertain
items.desc: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Josh Jacobs suffered a broken finger in Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: LaFleur added that the hope is that Jacobs can play with the injury, but the team is evaluating him further. His status will need to be further evaluated this upcoming week.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Darren Waller totals 90 yards and touchdown in Week 9
items.desc: Darren Waller caught eight of 10 targets for 90 yards and one touchdown in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
items.impact: Waller scored from 15 yards out in the third quarter to give Carolina a 14-13 lead. He also led the Panthers in receptions, targets, and receiving yards. That's a significant improvement from his one-catch, 11-yard performance in Week 8. Waller was Bryce Young's primary receiving option Sunday and has the production to warrant consideration as a fantasy starter against the Saints in Week 10.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Chuba Hubbard rushes for 79 yards in Week 9
items.desc: Chuba Hubbard rushed 16 times for 79 yards while catching four of five targets for 17 yards in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
items.impact: Hubbard averaged 4.9 yards per carry and accounted for 16 of Carolina's 20 rushing attempts. More importantly, he handled 20 touches while the Panthers' other running backs combined for just two carries. The workload is there, even if the touchdowns weren't. Hubbard remains Carolina's primary running back heading into Week 10 against New Orleans.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Bryce Young throws three touchdowns in Week 9
items.desc: Bryce Young completed 28 of 39 passes for 276 yards, three touchdowns, and one interception while rushing once for 13 yards in the Panthers' 26-21 loss to the Broncos in Week 9.
items.impact: Young threw touchdowns to Tommy Tremble, Darren Waller, and Tetairoa McMillan against Denver's defense. The problem? He also threw an interception in the end zone and lost a fumble on Carolina's final possession. Young produced three passing touchdowns against a difficult matchup, but the turnovers proved costly. He gets the Saints in Week 10.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Drew Lock (oblique) uncertain for Week 10
items.desc: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Drew Lock suffered an oblique injury and it's up in the air if he'll be available next week.
items.impact: Lock was pretty clearly hampered to end the game on Sunday against the Cardinals. Pending the status of Sam Darnold, it could be Jalen Milroe getting his first career start in Week 10 against the Raiders.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Broncos D/ST forces two turnovers in Week 9
items.desc: The Broncos' defense allowed 21 points and 353 total yards while recording three sacks, an interception, and a fumble recovery in Denver's 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
items.impact: Nik Bonitto stripped Bryce Young and recovered the fumble with 1:24 remaining to secure Denver's fifth straight win. The Broncos also intercepted Young in the end zone during the third quarter. Denver allowed three passing touchdowns, but the three sacks and two takeaways helped offset the points allowed. The Broncos remain a strong fantasy defense, although they are entering their Week 10 bye.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Wil Lutz makes two field goals in Week 9
items.desc: Wil Lutz converted field goals from 26 and 48 yards in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
items.impact: Lutz has now made seven field goals over Denver's last three games. The Broncos scored 26 points Sunday, giving Lutz another productive afternoon. Denver enters its Week 10 bye before hosting the Raiders in Week 11.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. held without receiving yards in Week 9
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. caught one of two targets for zero yards in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
items.impact: Mims followed his 10-yard receiving performance in Week 8 with zero receiving yards Sunday. He has just five catches over his last three games, and Denver continues to spread targets among several receivers. The former second-round pick doesn't have enough receiving volume to justify a fantasy roster spot in most leagues.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Troy Franklin records 31 receiving yards in Week 9
items.desc: Troy Franklin caught three of four targets for 31 yards in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
items.impact: Franklin finished behind Courtland Sutton and Pat Bryant in receiving yards while seeing fewer targets than both players. Denver has continued spreading opportunities among its receivers, limiting Franklin's fantasy production. He remains a depth option rather than a reliable weekly starter.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Evan Engram records 33 receiving yards in Week 9
items.desc: Evan Engram caught four of five targets for 33 yards in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
items.impact: Engram entered Sunday with two receiving yards over his previous two games combined. So, four catches for 33 yards represent an improvement. That said, Engram still hasn't established himself as a consistent part of Denver's passing attack. He remains difficult to start in fantasy leagues outside of deeper formats.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Jaylen Waddle suffers concussion in Week 9
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle caught his only target for 22 yards before exiting the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9 with a concussion.
items.impact: Waddle suffered the injury on a hit from Panthers safety Zakee Wheatley while attempting to make a reception downfield. He was subsequently ruled out for the remainder of the game. Meanwhile, Courtland Sutton saw nine targets, while Pat Bryant caught four passes for 56 yards and a touchdown. Denver enters its Week 10 bye, giving Waddle additional time to clear the concussion protocol before facing the Raiders in Week 11. His availability remains uncertain.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Pat Bryant scores touchdown in Week 9
items.desc: Pat Bryant caught four of five targets for 56 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
items.impact: Bryant caught a 26-yard touchdown from Bo Nix in the fourth quarter, extending Denver's lead to 26-14. He also led the Broncos in receiving yards. Bryant's five targets matched Evan Engram for second on the team behind Courtland Sutton. With Jaylen Waddle seeing just one target, Bryant's involvement is worth monitoring heading into Denver's Week 10 bye.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Courtland Sutton catches touchdown in Week 9
items.desc: Courtland Sutton caught five of nine targets for 45 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
items.impact: Sutton scored from three yards out in the first quarter for his first touchdown since Week 1. He also led Denver with nine targets, nearly doubling his four targets from Week 8. That's the good. The bad? Sutton still hasn't surpassed 60 receiving yards in a game this season. The touchdown helps, but one productive fantasy performance doesn't erase eight weeks of limited production.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: J.K. Dobbins struggles again in Week 9
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins finished with one reception for four yards as the Broncos defeated the Panthers 26-21 in Week 9.
items.impact: Dobbins has lost considerable ground to Jonah Coleman over the last three games. The latter had 21 touches for 88 yards and a touchdown Sunday. Dobbins, meanwhile, hasn't scored since Week 7. The Broncos have shifted their backfield toward Coleman, leaving Dobbins difficult to trust as a fantasy starter.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Jonah Coleman scores touchdown in Week 9
items.desc: Jonah Coleman rushed 17 times for 57 yards and one touchdown while catching four passes for 31 yards in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
items.impact: Coleman scored from nine yards out in the fourth quarter to give Denver a 19-14 lead. More importantly, he has now led the Broncos in rushing in three straight games since returning from injured reserve. Coleman also caught four passes for the second consecutive week. So, what happened to J.K. Dobbins' role? Coleman has taken over a significant portion of the backfield, including scoring opportunities. The rookie has established himself as Denver's most productive fantasy running back.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Bo Nix throws two touchdowns again in Week 9
items.desc: Bo Nix completed 25 of 37 passes for 237 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in the Broncos' 26-21 win over the Panthers in Week 9.
items.impact: Nix threw touchdowns to Courtland Sutton and Pat Bryant, including a 26-yard score to the latter in the fourth quarter. The Broncos quarterback has now thrown six touchdowns over his last three games. That said, Nix has been less productive on the ground since his 74-yard rushing performance in Week 7. Denver gets a Week 10 bye before facing the Raiders in Week 11.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs reaches end zone in Week 9 win over Dolphins
items.desc: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 20 times for 74 yards and one touchdown while failing to catch his lone target in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: Gibbs has been dynamic out of the backfield of late, rushing for one or more touchdowns in five of his last six games. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jared Goff bottled up in Week 9 win
items.desc: Jared Goff completed 17-of-25 pass attempts for 170 yards and one interception in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: Goff is in the middle of an uncomfortable stretch behind center, passing for less than 180 yards in each of the last two games. The quarterback will look to return to his impactful form against the New England Patriots in Week 10.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown leads pass-catchers in Week 9 win over Dolphins
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauled in eight of his team-leading 10 targets for 86 yards in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: St. Brown continues an impactful stretch in the Detroit passing attack, recording six or more receptions in seven of eight contests. The wideout remains locked in as a consistent WR1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jameson Williams sees two touches in Week 9 win
items.desc: Jameson Williams hauled in one of his two targets for 31 yards while also rushing once for nine yards in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: Williams was bottled up by an underrated Miami defense, finishing with less than 50 receiving yards for the first time in his last six games. The wideout will look to return to his explosive form against the New England Patriots in Week 10.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sam LaPorta sees five targets in Week 9 win
items.desc: Sam LaPorta hauled in four of his five targets for 32 yards in the Lions' 19-9 Week 9 win over the Dolphins.
items.impact: LaPorta remains consistently involved in the Detroit passing attack of late, recording five or more targets in four of his last five contests. The tight end remains one of the more stable pass-catching options as part of a prolific Detroit offense heading into a Week 10 matchup against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sione Vaki sees five touches in Week 9
items.desc: Sione Vaki rushed three times for 14 yards while also catching both of his targets for seven yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
items.impact: Vaki has made minimal impact out of the Detroit backfield, recording less than 25 offensive yards in four of his last five games. The running back remains more of a handcuff option to No. 1 running back Jahmyr Gibbs ahead of a Week 10 contest against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Isaac TeSlaa quiet in Week 9 win
items.desc: Isaac TeSlaa caught one of his two targets for nine yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
items.impact: TeSlaa has made minimal impact on offense of late, finishing with 10 receiving yards or less in each of his last four contests. The wideout remains one of the more streaky pass-catching options with plenty of explosive potential heading into a Week 10 contest against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Conklin sees one target in Week 9
items.desc: Tyler Conklin failed to catch his only target in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
items.impact: Conklin has been non-existent in the Detroit offense, logging one target or less in each of his last four contests. The wideout cannot be trusted in any format currently, with a Week 10 contest against the New England Patriots up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: DeAndre Carter catches pass in Week 9
items.desc: DeAndre Carter caught his only target for five yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
items.impact: Carter has been an afterthought in the Detroit offense, seeing his first target of the season in Sunday's win. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 10 contest against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tay Martin catches pass in Week 9
items.desc: Tay Martin caught his only target for 11 yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
items.impact: Martin has been non-existent on offense to this point, seeing his first target of the season in Sunday's win. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats heading into a Week 10 contest against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Lions D/ST stands tall in Week 9
items.desc: The Lions D/ST recorded three sacks while also forcing one turnover (one interception) in a 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
items.impact: The defense took advantage of an underperforming Miami offense, allowing 228 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look for a more disruptive performance in Week 10 against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jake Bates racks up 13 points in Week 9
items.desc: Jake Bates converted all four of his field goal attempts as well as his lone extra point attempt to finish with 13 points in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins in Week 9.
items.impact: Bates continues to take advantage of playing behind a prolific Detroit offense, registering seven or more points in each of his eight contests. The kicker remains locked in as an impactful option in kicker formats entering a Week 10 contest against the New England Patriots.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Caleb Douglas leads pass-catchers in Week 9 loss to Lions
items.desc: Caleb Douglas hauled in six of his team-high eight targets for 70 yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 Week 9 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Douglas has been impactful despite inconsistent usage in the Miami offense of late, recording 70 receiving yards in two of his last three contests. The wideout offers fantasy managers one of the few reliable options in an underperforming Miami offense to this point, with a Week 10 contest against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ollie Gordon II leads backfield in Week 9 loss to Lions
items.desc: Ollie Gordon II carried the ball 16 times for 55 yards while also hauling in his lone target for nine yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 Week 9 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Gordon II has capitalized on increased touches out of the Miami backfield of late, logging over 60 offensive yards in each of his last five contests. The running back remains one of the few stable options as part of an underwhelming Miami offense to this point ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Malik Washington quiet in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Malik Washington caught two of his three targets for 21 yards while also rushing once for no gain in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions in Week 9.
items.impact: Washington has cooled off in the Miami offense of late, finishing with less than 50 receiving yards in each of his last four contests. The wideout remains another inconsistent option as part of an underperforming Miami offense to this point, with a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Malik Willis dismal in Week 9 loss to Lions
items.desc: Malik Willis completed 13-of-25 pass attempts for 128 yards and one interception while also rushing twice for seven yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 Week 9 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Willis has struggled behind center of late, throwing at least one interception in three of his last four contests. The quarterback has disappointed for much of the season while leading an inconsistent Miami offense, with a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Josh Downs goes for 24 yards in Week 9
items.desc: Josh Downs caught three of his six targets for 24 yards in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
items.impact: Downs was quiet in what could be his final game with the Colts as trade rumors have popped up surrounding the slot receiver. If Downs ultimately ends up staying in Indy, he will go up against the Dolphins in Week 10.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Keenan Allen hauls in four passes in Week 9
items.desc: Keenan Allen caught four of his eight targets for 26 yards in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
items.impact: Allen led the team with his eight targets but wasn't able to do much with the opportunities. The veteran wideout has emerged as one of Daniel Jones' favorite targets this season, catching 40 passes for 351 yards and one touchdown in eight games. Allen will be a flex option in Week 10 vs. the Dolphins.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Puka Nacua suffers knee injury Sunday
items.desc: Puka Nacua suffered a knee injury on the final play of Sunday's contest between the Los Angeles Rams and Washington Commanders according to Mike Garafolo.
items.impact: Nacua will undergo an MRI Monday to determine the severity of the injury, although the team believes the wideout avoided an ACL injury in Sunday's win. Nacua hauled in 14 of his team-leading 19 targets for 150 yards and one touchdown while also rushing twice for 20 yards prior to suffering the injury.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Seth McGowan finds the end zone in Week 9
items.desc: Seth McGowan carried the ball six times for 45 yards and a touchdown while losing three yards on his lone reception in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
items.impact: McGowan punched in a two-yard touchdown in the first quarter to give the Colts their first points of the game. The rookie running back could be the team's starting running back in Week 10 against the Dolphins if the Colts wind up trading Jonathan Taylor by Tuesday's trade deadline. McGowan would be a locked-in RB2 in fantasy for Week 10 if that were to happen.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jonathan Taylor loses fumble in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Jonathan Taylor carried the ball 13 times for 46 yards while catching all five of his targets for 18 yards and losing a fumble in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
items.impact: Taylor struggled in what might have been his final game in a Colts uniform with trade rumors swirling around him. The veteran running back has rushed for 656 yards and eight touchdowns through nine games this year. If the Colts don't trade him by Tuesday's trade deadline, he will face the Dolphins in Week 10.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Greg Dulcich catches two passes in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Greg Dulcich caught two of his four targets for 14 yards in the Dolphins' 19-9 Week 9 loss to the Lions.
items.impact: Dulcich has seen increased involvement in the Miami passing attack of late, logging four or more targets in each of his last four contests. The tight end remains one of many risky pass-catching options in the Miami offense ahead of a Week 10 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Daniel Jones throws one TD in Week 9
items.desc: Daniel Jones completed 20 of 34 passes for 180 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while adding 11 yards on three rushes in a 27-23 loss to the Cowboys in Week 9.
items.impact: Jones almost led the Colts to an upset win over the Cowboys at home, as the Colts were up 23-20 with under two minutes left in the game. His lone touchdown pass went to Ashton Dulin on a 55-yard completion in the third quarter. Jones has thrown just six touchdowns and nine interceptions through nine games in what has been a disappointing season for him. A low-end QB2 in fantasy moving forward, he will take on the Dolphins in Week 10.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Chris Bell quiet in Week 9 loss
items.desc: Chris Bell failed to catch his lone target in the Dolphins' 19-9 loss to the Lions in Week 9.
items.impact: Bell has struggled to make an impact of late, finishing with under 35 receiving yards in each of his last five games. The wideout remains another risky pass-catching option in an inconsistent Miami offense ahead of a Week 10 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.
